Hero.title: EHR, Rebuilt from Scratch.
Hero.subtitle: A next-generation Electronic Medical Records system where AI isn't a plugin — it's the foundation.
Hero.subhero: Every vital sign, every lab, every note — alive with meaning, ready to act.
Hero.subheroDetail: Built on a clinical ontology engine, AI Native EHR transforms raw medical data into a living knowledge graph. Autonomous AI agents continuously interpret context, detect patterns, and trigger actions — from real-time clinical decision support to automated coding and referral generation. Not a static database. A system that understands medicine the way clinicians do.

Problem.label: The Problem
Problem.title: Legacy EHRs Were Never Built for AI
Problem.subtitle: Today's EHR systems treat AI as an afterthought — bolted-on modules that fight against rigid data models and manual workflows.
Problem.stat3Label: of clinical time lost to admin tasks

Features.label: Core Features
Features.title: Eight Pillars of AI Native Care
Features.subtitle: Every feature is designed with AI at its core — not retrofitted onto legacy architecture.
Features.f1Desc: Voice or text input automatically transforms into structured SOAP notes. Speak naturally — the AI handles the rest.
Features.f2Desc: Prescribe in natural language. Say 'Tylenol 500mg TID for 5 days' and get a fully structured, verified order.
Features.f3Desc: Automatic ICD/KCD code recommendations based on clinical documentation. No more manual code hunting.
Features.f4Desc: Real-time alerts for drug interactions, contraindications, and guideline-based recommendations.
Features.f5Desc: Complex patient charts distilled into clear, AI-generated summaries. Instant context for every encounter.
Features.f6Desc: Automatically draft referral and response letters from clinical context. Review and send in seconds.
Features.f7Desc: AI optimizes insurance claims based on review criteria, reducing denials and maximizing reimbursement.
Features.f8Desc: AI-powered chatbot for patients — appointment scheduling, result explanations, and medication reminders.

HowItWorks.label: How It Works
HowItWorks.title: Three Steps. Zero Friction.
HowItWorks.subtitle: From voice to verified record — AI handles the complexity so you can focus on care.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Talk to your patient naturally. The AI listens and captures every clinical detail in real-time.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: AI transforms your conversation into SOAP notes, orders, diagnosis codes, and billing data — instantly.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Review the AI-generated documentation. One tap to confirm. You stay in control, always.
